title: Anticheat ZKML
tagline: Cheat on Anti-cheating ZKML Prover, we use Verifiable Machine Learning to implement ZKML spoofing
description:
A zero-knowledge (ZK) proof is a cryptographic protocol in which one party, the prover, can prove to another party, the verifier, that a given statement is true, without revealing any additional information beyond the fact that the statement is true. 
We try to use it to Verifiable Machine Learning.
how_its_made:
We proposed Verifiable Machine Unlearning
, this is an innovative thinking, thinking backwards about how to solve the problem of personal privacy protection and maintain data sovereignty.
We finally used ZK, cryptography, python, and react to complete the product. ZK and cryptography are the underlying architecture, python is the core technology, and react completes the front-end.
